title: Style guides and terminology reach AI translation
summary: Style guides, terminology-aware AI translation, TM file import and export, a Cosmos LLM node, a choice of lip-sync models and API keys.

items.title: Style guides are their own module.
items.body: Upload up to 10 files (PDF, Word, Markdown, text) and Gemini extracts the rules, one rule set per language plus a general set. Link a guide to a memory and AI translation follows it. Find it in the new **Style guides** tab under Translation Memory.

children.body: Adding files only ever _adds_ rules: hand edits are never overwritten, and removing a file keeps its rules.
**Extract again** is the only full rebuild.

items.title: Terminology now reaches AI translation.
items.body: Only the terms that actually occur in each text are sent with it, never the whole term base, so cost scales with your texts, not the size of the base.

children.body: Rejected and forbidden terms are never used.
The model is told to inflect terms to fit the sentence.

items.title: Import and export real TM files,
items.body: with downloadable templates.

children.body: XLIFF 1.2 and 2.x, including Trados, memoQ and Phrase flavours.

items.title: VitraTM for every language.
items.body: It was enabled on 170 of 1,087 catalogue languages. It now covers all of them, plus 88 newly added languages (1,175 in the catalogue).

items.title: Generic LLM node.
items.body: Pick the input and output modality, system instruction and model when building the flow, and add a prompt per run. The canvas only lets you connect steps whose modalities match, and an input too big for the model's context window is refused _before_ it costs anything.
Text and Office inputs can now feed image and video models, so a Markdown brief can drive an image step.
Same-format Office steps (docx to docx, pptx to pptx, xlsx to xlsx) are edited in place, so the original styling survives.

items.title: View output on every step.
items.body: Use **View output** in the run timeline to preview HTML, Markdown, JSON, images, video and PDF.

items.title: Choose your lip-sync model,
items.body: including fal LatentSync. The export panel shows the model and its price, and models with no vendor key are flagged instead of failing.

items.title: OpenAI is now the default
items.body: for image translation, Image Creator and Adapts. Organizations that already chose a provider keep it.

items.title: Office translation handles CSV and XLSX,
items.body: with header-row detection and embedded-image preview.
The adaptive image modal is reworked, Quick Create errors are clearer, raw output has an HTML preview, and the QC report accuracy view is sharper.
VitraAI agent passes (QC report, proofreading, back-translation) retry and fall back to a second model instead of failing the pass.

items.title: Voice cloning
items.body: tries Cartesia first, then ElevenLabs, and English (India) is now a Cartesia clone language. Existing Cartesia clones can be used for English (India) dubs too.

items.title: API keys.
items.body: Organization-scoped keys (`uvk_…`), managed at `/v1/api-keys`. A key can never do more than the person who created it, in the one organization it belongs to. Creating and revoking keys is audited.

items.title: Agent skills
items.body: built on those keys: video dubbing, image creation, image translation and image resize, as drop-in skills for any agent runtime.

items.title: Indic terms were never matched.
items.body: Word boundaries split Bengali and Hindi terms at their vowel signs, so multi-word terms were silently dropped from the term index.

items.title: Some languages had the wrong code.
items.body: 17 pairs of languages (Konkani, Akan, Chinese and others) shared one internal name, so one could resolve to the other's code.

children.body: 21 labels that showed raw ISO codes now show language names.
ar-IL, ar-MR and ar-PS now display right to left.

items.title: Lip-sync exports ignored the organization's model
items.body: and always used lipsync-2. Exports without a vendor key are no longer marked or billed as lip-sync.

items.title: Large Gemini batch translations could fail after being paid for.
items.body: They could exceed the output limit. They are now split to fit it.

items.title: Nano Banana Pro failed at run time.
items.body: It now uses the stable model.

items.title: Cosmos galaxy nodes dropped run-time fields
items.body: from the run modal.

items.title: Membership errors showed as a generic server error.
items.body: They now come back as clear request or permission errors.
